text: My name is XXXX XXXX XXXX. I am submitting this complaint on behalf of myself without any third parties. On XX/XX/2024, I received an email from CREDIT MANAGEMENT, L.P., without prior consent, in regards to an alleged debt owed from a " XXXX XXXX XXXX XXXX XXXX' See exhibit A. On XX/XX/2024, I emailed the above-mentioned back requesting validation pursuant to 15 U.S. Code 1692g as well as a Cease and Desist pursuant to 15 U.S. Code 1692c. See exhibit B and exhibit C. Today, XX/XX/2024 at XXXX, I received a text message from CREDIT MANAGEMENT, L.P., without my prior consent, once again, and a Cease and Desist already in place on XX/XX/2024. See exhibit D. The above-mentioned are in direct violation 15 U.S. Code 1692c as they've continue to attempt to communicate despite issued Cease and Desist. See exhibit E. Anyone that fails to comply with provisions of 15 U.S. Code 1692 subchapter with respect, therefore, liable to such person in an amount equal to the sum of ( 1 ) any actual damage sustained by such person as a result of such failure ; ( 2 ) ( A ) in the case of any action by an individual, such additional damages as the court may allow, but not exceeding {$1000.00}. See exhibit F.
